key: Hello, Trainer. Challenging the Gym League, are you?
en: Hello, Trainer. Challenging the Gym League, are you?
ja: こんにちは　トレーナーさん。ジムリーグに　挑戦してるのね?

key: You know, our daughter is a Gym Leader!
en: You know, our daughter is a Gym Leader!
ja: 実は　うちの娘　ジムリーダーなのよ!

key: Actually, she's lots of things!
en: Actually, she's lots of things!
ja: というか　いろんな顔を　持っててね!

key: Computer technician, lion tamer at Agate Circus!
en: Computer technician, lion tamer at Agate Circus!
ja: コンピューター技術者だったり　アゲートサーカスの　ライオン使いだったり!

key: We are SO proud of her.
en: We are SO proud of her.
ja: わたしたち　娘のこと　すっごく　誇りに思ってるの。

key: She's a real peach; I'm sure you'd absolutely love her!
en: She's a real peach; I'm sure you'd absolutely love her!
ja: 本当に　いい子でね　きっと　あなたも　大好きに　なると思うわ!

key: You know, for a while, we were really worried about our little girl.
en: You know, for a while, we were really worried about our little girl.
ja: 実は　しばらくの間　あの子のこと　すごく　心配してたの。

key: She always locked herself away in her room, and she was so shy she wouldn't talk to anyone!
en: She always locked herself away in her room, and she was so shy she wouldn't talk to anyone!
ja: いつも　部屋に　閉じこもってて　人見知りで　誰とも　話さなかったのよ!

key: She wasn't the type to make friends at school, but she never went anywhere else, so she just played video games all day.
en: She wasn't the type to make friends at school, but she never went anywhere else, so she just played video games all day.
ja: 学校で　友達を　作るタイプでも　なかったし　かといって　他に　どこにも　行かなくて　一日中　ゲームばかり　してたわ。

key: What kind of future can someone like that have, we thought?
en: What kind of future can someone like that have, we thought?
ja: あんな調子で　この子に　どんな未来が　あるんだろうって　思ってた。

key: Then one day, just all of a sudden, she told us she was going off to pursue her life's secret dream of joining the circus.
en: Then one day, just all of a sudden, she told us she was going off to pursue her life's secret dream of joining the circus.
ja: それが　ある日　突然　サーカスに入るのが　人生の秘めた夢だったって　言い出して　旅立って　いっちゃったの。

key: And she did great!
en: And she did great!
ja: そしたら　大成功!

key: Maybe sometimes you just gotta let kids do their thing until they're ready.
en: Maybe sometimes you just gotta let kids do their thing until they're ready.
ja: 子どもって　時には　準備が　整うまで　好きに　させてあげるのも　大事なのかもね。

key: Everything that happened to our girl is a little hard to believe...
en: Everything that happened to our girl is a little hard to believe...
ja: あの子の身に　起きたこと　正直　信じがたいけど……

key: But if it is true, then we owe you big time.
en: But if it is true, then we owe you big time.
ja: でも　もし　本当なら　あなたには　大きな借りが　あるわ。

key: Thanks for bringing her back.
en: Thanks for bringing her back.
ja: あの子を　連れ戻してくれて　ありがとう。

key: We've been so lonely after our daughter took off to go earn her place in the world.
en: We've been so lonely after our daughter took off to go earn her place in the world.
ja: 娘が　自分の居場所を　見つけに　旅立ってから　ずっと　寂しくてね。

key: It's normal for parents after the kid leaves the nest, I think.
en: It's normal for parents after the kid leaves the nest, I think.
ja: 子どもが　巣立ったあとの　親って　みんな　そんなものだと　思うけど。

key: Of course, I'm happy she's off living her life.
en: Of course, I'm happy she's off living her life.
ja: もちろん　あの子が　自分の人生を　生きてるのは　うれしいのよ。

key: It's just...
en: It's just...
ja: ただ……

key: She changed so drastically in a short period of time.
en: She changed so drastically in a short period of time.
ja: 短い間に　あまりにも　劇的に　変わってしまって。

key: I would be lying if I said I hadn't thought drugs were involved, but she always came up totally clean.
en: I would be lying if I said I hadn't thought drugs were involved, but she always came up totally clean.
ja: 薬でも　やってるんじゃないかって　思わなかったと言えば　ウソに　なるけど　検査は　いつも　完全に　シロだった。

key: Strange, children can be.
en: Strange, children can be.
ja: 子どもって　不思議なものね。

key: Maybe our daughter changed as a result of meeting that girl...
en: Maybe our daughter changed as a result of meeting that girl...
ja: もしかして　あの子が　変わったのは　あの女の子に　出会ったから　なのかも……

key: The timing makes sense, but how could a kid like that have such an impact on her?
en: The timing makes sense, but how could a kid like that have such an impact on her?
ja: タイミング的には　つじつまが合うけど　あんな子に　そこまでの影響力が　あるものかしら?

key: I would say one never knows what might become a formative experience, but...
en: I would say one never knows what might become a formative experience, but...
ja: 人格を形づくる経験って　何が　きっかけに　なるか　わからないもの　とは言うけれど……

key: It doesn't quite add up, you know?
en: It doesn't quite add up, you know?
ja: どうも　しっくり　こないのよね?

key: If she went into social work, for instance, after we tried to adopt that orphan girl, it would make sense.
en: If she went into social work, for instance, after we tried to adopt that orphan girl, it would make sense.
ja: たとえば　あの孤児の女の子を　養子に　しようとしたあとに　福祉の仕事に　進んだって言うなら　まだ　わかるのよ。

key: But the Circus? Where did that come from!?
en: But the Circus? Where did that come from!?
ja: でも　サーカス? どこから　出てきたのよ、それ!?

key: It's almost like she became a completely different person overnight.
en: It's almost like she became a completely different person overnight.
ja: まるで　一晩で　まったくの別人に　なっちゃったみたい。

key: Ah well, as long as she's happy.
en: Ah well, as long as she's happy.
ja: まあ　あの子が　幸せなら　いいけど。

key: Ah...
en: Ah...
ja: ああ……

key: If our daughter joins a terrorist organization and then gets deleted and recovered from a fantasy space void by the powers of God...
en: If our daughter joins a terrorist organization and then gets deleted and recovered from a fantasy space void by the powers of God...
ja: もし　うちの娘が　テロ組織に入って　それから　消去されて　神様の力で　幻想的な宇宙の虚空から　回収されたんだとしたら……

key: Uh, does that make us bad parents?
en: Uh, does that make us bad parents?
ja: ねえ　それって　わたしたち　ダメな親って　ことに　なるのかしら?

key: Guests and registered visitors only beyond the lobby, please.
en: Guests and registered visitors only beyond the lobby, please.
ja: ロビーより先は　ご来賓および　登録済みの　訪問者のみ　お通りいただけます。

key: ATTENDANT: Excuse me!
en: ATTENDANT: Excuse me!
ja: 係員: すみません!

key: Something unseeable is in the way.
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
ja: 何か　見えない　気配が　道を　ふさいでいる。

key: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
en: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
ja: \PNは　シルボンスコープを　使った。

key: The startled Pokémon attacked!
en: The startled Pokémon attacked!
ja: 驚いた　ポケモンが　おそいかかってきた!

key: TERRA: Mom, Dad, you here?
en: TERRA: Mom, Dad, you here?
ja: テラ: ママ　パパ　いる?

key: MOM: Honey, how've you been?!
en: MOM: Honey, how've you been?!
ja: 母: あなた　元気にしてた?!

key: It's so nice to see you!
en: It's so nice to see you!
ja: 会えて　本当に　うれしいわ!

key: How long has it been?
en: How long has it been?
ja: どれくらい　ぶりかしら?

key: We've seen you on the posters, and you know we are SO proud.
en: We've seen you on the posters, and you know we are SO proud.
ja: ポスターで　見たわよ　ほんとに　誇らしくて。

key: I love the hair, but I can see those roots!
en: I love the hair, but I can see those roots!
ja: その髪型　素敵だけど　根元　伸びてるじゃない!

key: DAD: To what do we owe the pleasure all of the sudden?
en: DAD: To what do we owe the pleasure all of the sudden?
ja: 父: 急に　どうしたんだ　今日は?

key: TERRA: I brought a friend.
en: TERRA: I brought a friend.
ja: テラ: 友達を　連れてきたの。

key: This is \PN. He's the champion.
en: This is \PN. He's the champion.
ja: こちら\PN。彼が　チャンピオンだよ。

key: This is \PN. She's the champion.
en: This is \PN. She's the champion.
ja: こちら\PN。彼女が　チャンピオンだよ。

key: This is \PN. They're the champion.
en: This is \PN. They're the champion.
ja: こちら\PN。この人が　チャンピオンだよ。

key: DAD: Well, well, well...
en: DAD: Well, well, well...
ja: 父: ほう　これは　これは……

key: Nice to meet you, Champion.
en: Nice to meet you, Champion.
ja: はじめまして　チャンピオン。

key: Thanks for being a friend to our daughter.
en: Thanks for being a friend to our daughter.
ja: 娘の　友達で　いてくれて　ありがとう。

key: Just a peach, isn't she?
en: Just a peach, isn't she?
ja: ほんと　いい子でしょう?

key: TERRA: Stop it, Dad.
en: TERRA: Stop it, Dad.
ja: テラ: やめてよ　パパ。

key: Actually, there's something I should tell you guys...
en: Actually, there's something I should tell you guys...
ja: ていうか　二人に　話さなきゃいけないことが　あって……

key: I brought \PN because I thought it might help to have someone else who was involved, and who's trustworthy.
en: I brought \PN because I thought it might help to have someone else who was involved, and who's trustworthy.
ja: \PNを　連れてきたのは　この件に　関わってて　信頼できる人が　いたほうが　いいかなって　思ったから。

key: But I got mixed up in something I shouldn't have, and I did some... less than great things.
en: But I got mixed up in something I shouldn't have, and I did some... less than great things.
ja: でも　あたし　関わっちゃいけないことに　巻き込まれて　その……　あんまり　褒められたことじゃないことも　したの。

key: DAD: Oh, come on, the circus isn't that bad.
en: DAD: Oh, come on, the circus isn't that bad.
ja: 父: おいおい　サーカスなんて　そこまで　悪いもんじゃ　ないだろう。

key: MOM: Not now, darling...
en: MOM: Not now, darling...
ja: 母: 今は　やめて　あなた……

key: DAD: Right, right... Sorry, go on?
en: DAD: Right, right... Sorry, go on?
ja: 父: ああ　そうだな……　悪い　続けてくれ?

key: TERRA: Before I left, I was bored.
en: TERRA: Before I left, I was bored.
ja: テラ: 家を出る前　あたし　退屈してたの。

key: Actually, maybe more like depressed.
en: Actually, maybe more like depressed.
ja: ううん　どっちかというと　鬱だったのかも。

key: MOM: Depressed?
en: MOM: Depressed?
ja: 母: 鬱?

key: I mean-- honey, that's serious...
en: I mean-- honey, that's serious...
ja: それって―― あなた　それは　深刻な話よ……

key: Did we... do something?
en: Did we... do something?
ja: わたしたち……　何か　した?

key: TERRA: Probably not.
en: TERRA: Probably not.
ja: テラ: たぶん　違う。

key: I don't know what could have been done.
en: I don't know what could have been done.
ja: 何が　できたのかも　わかんない。

key: I just realized how inconsequential everything was.
en: I just realized how inconsequential everything was.
ja: ただ　全部が　どうでもいいことに　思えちゃって。

key: A normal family with a normal life and perfectly reasonable parents...
en: A normal family with a normal life and perfectly reasonable parents...
ja: 普通の家族と　普通の生活　まっとうすぎる親……

key: To a lot of people, I'm sure that's way more than they ever had, and I'm just selfish and spoiled.
en: To a lot of people, I'm sure that's way more than they ever had, and I'm just selfish and spoiled.
ja: 世の中の多くの人にとっては　それだけでも　十分すぎるくらいで　あたしは　ただの　わがままで　甘えた子どもなんだって。

key: But then, at least they had a reason for their problems.
en: But then, at least they had a reason for their problems.
ja: でも　それでも　みんなには　悩みに　ちゃんとした理由が　あった。

key: Stories are full of heroes and characters with zany powers, and this was just...
en: Stories are full of heroes and characters with zany powers, and this was just...
ja: 物語には　ヒーローとか　変な力を持ったキャラクターとか　いっぱい出てくるのに　あたしのは　ただ……

key: School.
en: School.
ja: 学校。

key: Home.
en: Home.
ja: 家。

key: Sleep.
en: Sleep.
ja: 睡眠。

key: Just like however many billion other people.
en: Just like however many billion other people.
ja: 他の何十億人と　同じ。

key: I wanted to do something different.
en: I wanted to do something different.
ja: 何か　違うことが　したかったの。

key: MOM: Sure, I don't see the problem...
en: MOM: Sure, I don't see the problem...
ja: 母: ええ　それの　何が　問題なのか　わからないけど……

key: DAD: And that's why you left.
en: DAD: And that's why you left.
ja: 父: それで　家を　出たんだな。

key: Do you still feel that way now?
en: Do you still feel that way now?
ja: 今でも　まだ　そう思ってるのか?

key: TERRA: No.
en: TERRA: No.
ja: テラ: ううん。

key: Not at all.
en: Not at all.
ja: 全然。

key: DAD: Then I'd say the lion-taming was worth it!
en: DAD: Then I'd say the lion-taming was worth it!
ja: 父: なら　ライオン使いに　なったかいが　あったってもんだな!

key: TERRA: ...This isn't about the circus, Dad.
en: TERRA: ...This isn't about the circus, Dad.
ja: テラ: ……サーカスの話じゃ　ないんだよ　パパ。

key: I got over it, and I'm still having lots of fun with the people I've met.
en: I got over it, and I'm still having lots of fun with the people I've met.
ja: あれは　もう　乗り越えたし　出会った人たちと　今も　すごく　楽しくやってる。

key: I'm lucky to have people like \PN who appreciate me.
en: I'm lucky to have people like \PN who appreciate me.
ja: \PNみたいに　あたしを　認めてくれる人が　いて　ラッキーだと思う。

key: I'm lucky to have people like \PN who tolerate me.
en: I'm lucky to have people like \PN who tolerate me.
ja: \PNみたいに　あたしを　大目に見てくれる人が　いて　ラッキーだと思う。

key: But there's a lot of guilt that I have to take responsibility for and still find a way to move forward with.
en: But there's a lot of guilt that I have to take responsibility for and still find a way to move forward with.
ja: でも　責任を　取らなきゃいけない罪悪感が　たくさん　あって　それでも　前に進む道を　見つけなきゃ　いけないの。

key: MOM: I don't understand what you mean.
en: MOM: I don't understand what you mean.
ja: 母: どういうこと　なのか　わからないわ。

key: TERRA: ...So, do you guys remember that girl that stayed with us for a bit?
en: TERRA: ...So, do you guys remember that girl that stayed with us for a bit?
ja: テラ: ……ねえ　しばらく　うちに泊まってた　あの女の子　覚えてる?

key: MOM: Of course!
en: MOM: Of course!
ja: 母: もちろんよ!

key: Quite a character she was!
en: Quite a character she was!
ja: なかなか　個性的な子だったわね!

key: TERRA: Yeah, so, turns out she actually kind of became god for a while.
en: TERRA: Yeah, so, turns out she actually kind of became god for a while.
ja: テラ: うん　それでね　実はあの子　しばらくの間　神様　みたいなものに　なってたの。

key: DAD: ...She what?
en: DAD: ...She what?
ja: 父: ……あの子が　何だって?
